notes: Fix 1: the shield's GND and VIN ports are screw-terminal ports, not the stacking header sockets. Joining them to the Uno's GND.1 and VIN header sockets was wrong, so I removed those two shield-to-Uno pairs (joined and electrical). The shield is still joined to the Uno through the control pins D12, D3, D9, A0, D13, D11, D8 and A1.

Fix 2: the motor leads and the battery holder leads are clamped in the shield's screw terminals. The compatible-join table has no pairing for lead or wire-end with screw. I kept each physical join as a joined edge between the parts with no ports named, and kept the electrical edges with exact ports. Motor 1 goes to A+ and motor 2 to A-. The holder positive goes to VIN and the holder negative to GND.
The two 18650 cells sit in the holder in series: cell1 + goes to the holder positive lead, cell1 - goes to cell2 +, and cell2 - goes to the holder negative lead. This is an assumption.
The USB cable is joined to the Uno with no port named, because the catalogue's Uno entry has no USB port. The computer is not modelled.
